_comment: M22: mindone_cpu_little, mindone_cpu_big and mindone_gpu are MAXIMUM virtual sensors over the LVTS zones and report only; the device tree owns CPU, GPU and skin passive cooling (kernel 99b64e3c36da). The HAL owns charger, modem and backlight requests. Physical watched sensors set TripPointIgnorable: r7 DT trips allow temperature writes but not hysteresis writes, and a failed write would otherwise force 2 s polling. ap_ntc trip 0 and soc_max trip 0 are the HAL-owned hot trips; ap_ntc trip 1 and soc_max trip 1 stay kernel-owned. md and ltepa_ntc have kernel polling-delay 0 and no kernel trip action, so no trip crossing event ever arrives; the HAL polls them every 5 s.

BindedCdevInfo._comment: charger-cooler max_state=8 (the kernel module tree charger_cooling.c: CHARGER_STATE_NUM=9, state0=unlimited). master_charger_state_to_current_limit (charger_cooling.c:26-28) = [-1(unlim), 2.6A, 2.2A, 1.8A, 1.4A, 1.0A, 0.7A, 0.5A, 0A]. Ladder below: NONE/LIGHT unlimited (state 0); MODERATE(45C, stock t3) -> state 3 (1.8A), matching the stock CV-reduction boundary; SEVERE(50C, stock t4) -> state 5 (1.0A); CRITICAL(53C) -> state 6 (0.7A); EMERGENCY(55C) -> state 8 (0A, charging halted) -- exactly the stock max_charge_temp hard-stop, now also visible to the framework/dumpsys; SHUTDOWN -> state 8 (already halted; device-level shutdown is the framework's job at this point, not the charger).

mutt-pa1 max_state=9 (the kernel module tree md_cooling.h: md_cooling_pdata.max_lv=9). state_to_mutt_lv(state)=state-1 sent to the modem firmware over CCCI as a MUTT throttle level; per md_cooling.c:134-148, state==max_lv(9) maps to MD_NO_IMS (IMS/VoLTE dropped, maximum throttle) and state==max_lv-1(8) to MD_IMS_ONLY. The driver's actual per-level TX-power-in-dB semantics live in modem firmware, not visible from the AP side -- this ladder only requests a MUTT severity level, it does not claim specific dB backoff numbers (the driver's tx_pwr_throttle/DEFAULT_THROTTLE_TX_PWR_LV1..3 = 4/6/8 dB path is a SEPARATE, currently-unwired cooling type on this DT, not what mutt-pa1 drives). Ladder: NONE/LIGHT unlimited; MODERATE(70C) -> level 2 (mild, early); SEVERE(80C) -> level 4; CRITICAL(90C) -> level 6; EMERGENCY(100C) -> level 8 (MD_IMS_ONLY); SHUTDOWN(115C) -> level 9 (MD_NO_IMS, maximum throttle -- defense in depth, the framework shutdown ladder also fires here).

lcd-backlight max_state=100, bl_percent=100-state (a brightness CEILING, not an override -- it composes with normal per-app brightness requests instead of fighting them). Deliberately left at state 0 through MODERATE/SEVERE (46/50C) so ordinary warm use never dims; only kicks in from CRITICAL up, when the device is genuinely hot and a small forced dim is an honest signal rather than a nuisance. CRITICAL(53C) state 15 (85% brightness ceiling); EMERGENCY(56C) state 30 (70%); SHUTDOWN(60C) state 45 (55%, defense in depth on the way to the framework's forced shutdown). UNCHANGED from v3.
